components.name: Channel list
components.description: Single-line grouped channels with aligned name, type, status, switch and text actions. Add is a text action at the upper left above the list; narrow views scroll horizontally without stacking rows. Synthetic preview; application handlers own edits and persistence. The searchable chooser presents three rows with SVG identity icons, a name and supporting explanation: Feishu Bot for manual credentials, Feishu personal app for QR registration, and Remote Nootify. Existing channels retain their actual connection-type label; personal editors hide manual credential fields. Personal authorization reuses the standard Magpie dialog. Active scans hide configuration fields and show a white-backed QR (184px), status, expiry, and official browser authorization action; Cancel remains available except while saving. Expired or failed scans offer retry, while an uncertain save asks the owner to check the channel list instead. Recover previous authorization restores the original target and sanitized flow after a page refresh or lost start response without creating another flow or resubmitting a save. Successful completion restores the personal editor with reconnect, same-app reauthorization, and required group/message permission inspection; missing scopes link to the official app console. QR and instructions stack with a (16px) gap. Buttons, inputs, and switches use genuine upstream controls with no local skin overrides: Cancel and browser authorization use the standard secondary button, while management actions use subtle buttons. Local helpers supply vertical form grouping, label spacing, header icon alignment, wrapping actions, and functional QR sizing. Channel chooser, editor, and delete confirmation share the upstream 440px bounded dialog, 24px padding, 14px corners, and standard action row with 20px top margin. Long forms scroll as a whole with their actions. The separate recipient picker retains its bounded list and footer outside the results scroller.

narrative.overview:
Nootify bundles the user-selected Magpie Design System v0.4.4 (commit fc0e8f1c43521b22b72d3be4223ea924189c1adb) for its complete application. Quiet neutral surfaces, blue actions, compact controls, and the penguin identity support everyday operation alongside coding tools. Chinese and English share the same hierarchy and follow system light/dark appearance.

The unmodified upstream CSS, fonts, and icons in `public/vendor/magpie/` own the palette, type roles, standard component skins, focus treatments, and reduced motion. Outfit supplies large titles and actions; Source Sans 3 supplies headings and reading/interface text. The upstream scale is 18px titles, 15px headings, 13px body/navigation, 12px notes/actions/code, and 11px captions. `public/styles.css` imports that system and owns Nootify's domain composition: navigation dimensions, live lists, grouped channels, recipient selection, and responsive dialogs. The frontmatter records the reused shipped tokens; upstream remains the implementation source of truth. Application adjustments stay outside the vendor directory.

The service checks stable latest from jsDelivr in the background at startup and every six hours, downloading complete size/SHA256-validated releases into `STATE_DIR/ui-assets/magpie`. Only a cache newer than the bundled baseline is preferred. Versioned same-origin stylesheets keep CSS imports and referenced fonts and icon masks on one release; updated stylesheets apply on the next page load, with a usable cache or bundled fallback offline. JavaScript helpers remain owned by the app. `npm run vendor:magpie` explicitly maintains the checked-in baseline; normal builds package it without CDN access.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral groups with fine row separators.
Outfit display/actions and Source Sans 3 reading roles.
Stable live lists and explicit dialog confirmation.

rules.name: The Role Continuity Rule
rules.body: Use accent for actions and focus; keep success, warning, and error colors tied to labeled states in both appearances.

rules.name: The Names First Rule
rules.body: Lead contact rows with human names; keep IDs and disambiguation subordinate and preserve already formatted aliases.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal separation for working groups; reserve diffuse elevation for menus and dialogs.

dos: Do use upstream component classes and semantic tokens, with application composition outside the vendor directory.
Do preserve useful loaded contacts, stable row identity, and a reachable recipient dialog footer during refresh.
Do keep portraits as runtime provider data and QR codes as functional imagery.
Do keep native checkbox semantics, visible keyboard focus, translated labels, and reduced motion.
Do use the operating system's native menu appearance and shortcuts for the tray.
donts: Don't persist a recipient from a row click; use explicit confirmation.
Don't let full IDs outrank human names or duplicate an alias already supplied by the provider.
Don't describe personal-app QR authorization as automatically granting missing group or message permissions.
Don't replace the authored dropdown with an operating-system select popup.
Don't expose background-service, module, or start/restart/install controls in the everyday tray menu.
